biomarkers.biomarker_other: BRCAness / DNA damage repair gene alterations (ATM, ATR, BRCA1, BRCA2, etc.)

source_quote.quote: "BRCAness" signature (ATM, ATR, BAP1, BRCA1, BRCA2, CDK12, CHEK1, CHEK2, FANCA, FANCC, FANCD2, FANCE, FANCF, PALB2, NGS1, WRN, RAD50, RAD51B, RAD51C, RAD51D, MRE11A, BLM, BRIP1)

coder_notes: Eligibility requires at least one DNA damage repair deficiency aberration (IDH mutation, PTEN mutation or BRCAness signature); all are matched to the PARP inhibitor talazoparib as the DDR-deficiency rationale. IDH mutation here is an IDH-mutant (not wildtype) marker used as a DDR-deficiency surrogate, so IDH-mutant tumours are explicitly allowed (historical terminology). Low-dose whole brain radiotherapy is given to increase drug penetration and is not an agent. Registry intervention list shows only Talazoparib with carboplatin as an alias.
